---
name: A gate cannot be passed honestly
about: A gate criterion that cannot be satisfied without inventing evidence
title: "[gate] <module> — criterion N"
labels: gate
---

The framework is meant to be demanding, not impossible. A gate that cannot be
passed honestly is a defect in the gate.

**Module and criterion**
<!-- e.g. 04-problem, criterion 2 — ">= 3 problems carrying [verified] evidence" -->

**What you were researching**
<!-- One line. Domain and stage are usually enough. -->

**What you could establish, and what you could not**
<!-- Be specific about the evidence you had access to. -->

**What you would have had to do to pass it**
<!-- If the honest answer is "invent something", say so — that is the finding. -->

**Did an escape hatch apply?**
<!-- e.g. did `declared_shortfall` cover this, and was it sufficient? -->
